import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    idx = 0
    n = data[idx]
    idx += 1

    arr = []
    for _ in range(n):
        arr.append(data[idx])
        idx += 1

    t = data[idx]

    arr.sort()

    best_len = 1
    for start in range(n):
        length = 1
        diff_sum = 0
        for end in range(start, n - 1):
            diff_sum += arr[end + 1] - arr[end]
            if diff_sum > t:
                break
            length += 1
        if length > best_len:
            best_len = length

    print(best_len)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
